The '''Tendrannan sector''' was one of three [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran sectors]] created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Planets in Tendrannan sector included [[Isiring]], which was the sector capital. The sector also contained the [[Kalki Nebula/Legends|Kalki Nebula]].
